difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-tensor-with-complex-homotopy at source lines 6155-6160: the functor of the preceding lemma, tensoring a dg E-module with the complex K, defines an exact functor of triangulated categories from the homotopy category of dg E-modules to the homotopy category of complexes of O-modules. The proof at source lines 6162-6181 is a short but genuine exactness check. It first passes to the homotopy categories using the author's functoriality lemma, and then has to show that distinguished triangles go to distinguished triangles. Concretely, starting from an admissible short exact sequence of dg E-modules, it uses a graded splitting of the sequence to build a map between the tensored terms, checks that the resulting sequence of complexes is termwise split exact, and concludes that it is a distinguished triangle in the homotopy category of complexes of O-modules. The substance is the transfer of the splitting through the tensor product and the recognition that a termwise split exact sequence of complexes gives a distinguished triangle. The statement records only the conclusion. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
